overview: An unusual Black reply 2...e5 that invites 3.Nxe5. Black has a pawn less, but gets open lines and quick development (...Qa5, ...d6) and the c5/e5 pawn structure is unbalanced. The line is rare and speculative; I am unsure of the exact main line.

white_ideas.idea: Take the e5 pawn and develop
Play d4 or Bc4 for central control

black_ideas.idea: Use open lines against the exposed e5 knight
Recover the pawn with active piece play

typical_structures.structure: Sicilian with c5 and a missing e-pawn

character.notes: Speculative, tactical play after an unorthodox Sicilian move.

gambit.notes: Black lets White capture e5 and the pawn can be kept.
